entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Segfault on Arm64 When Used With Emgu #38112
  • Complex type init only Discriminator mistakenly marked as modified when unchanged (regression) #38105
    11.0.0

Closed

  • ComplexProperty treated as nullable after update from EF Core 9.0 to 10.0.5 #38043
    10.0.7
  • Allow temporal Period properties to be mapped to CLR properties (i.e. not shadow properties) #26463
    11.0.0
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #38102
    8.0.23
  • EF Core 10.0.6 tools fail with `CSharpHelper.Identifier` missing implementation (loads `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design` 8.0.0.0) #38108
  • Add-Migration Exception: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Diagnostics.AbstractionsStrings.ArgumentIsEmpty(System.Object) #38107
  • RevEng: add a way to handle shadow properties when generating a entity code file #26007

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix .Update() marking AfterSaveBehavior.Throw properties as modified via DetectChanges #38115
  • Add NuGet dependency version bounds for EF Core inter-package references #38114
  • Fix complex type shadow discriminator incorrectly marked as modified on Update #38111

Merged

  • Allow temporal period properties to be mapped to CLR properties #38110
    api-review

  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0 #38098

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38106
